app.title: Smart greenhouse
app.subtitle: Zone monitor and environmental readings
steps.title: How to use this panel
steps.1: Create a zone in the left panel and select it to open its workspace.
steps.2: Use the Readings tab for history; Crops and Thresholds store cultivation context and target ranges.
steps.3: In the Readings tab, log temperature, humidity, light, or soil moisture using the form at the bottom.
ui.workspaceEmpty: Create your first zone using the panel on the left to see readings, crops, and thresholds.
crops.title: Crops in this zone
thresholds.title: Recommended thresholds by metric
thresholds.help: Provide at least a minimum or a maximum. Saving again for the same metric replaces it.
thresholds.needOne: Enter at least a minimum or a maximum.
thresholds.empty: No thresholds yet. Define a recommended range for each metric.
zones.title: Zones
zones.sidebarLead: Select a zone. The right-hand panel applies only to that zone.

auth.deployHint: If the site and API are on different domains, add VITE_API_PREFIX in Vercel (Settings → Environment Variables) set to your public API URL ending in /api, e.g. https://your-app.up.railway.app/api then trigger a new deploy (Rebuild).
